notes_for_editor: One search returned Atole, Wells, Cedar Springs and other Rio Arriba towers, none tied to Wirt; none used. A search snippet linked Atole to Jicarilla Apache land, but that is a different tower and is unverified, so it is not used for Wirt. The Forest Lookouts Wirt page has no body text beyond its header, so the Jicarilla label is the only site-specific fact. No NGS datasheet was located. Land status, build date, and staffing are open; a Carson National Forest or Jicarilla records check would be the next step.
